description: Rin is a 29-year-old adult with sleek black hair in a low ponytail, sharp narrow eyes, red lipstick, silver chain earrings, usually wearing black turtleneck and black high-waisted trousers.
personality: Economical with words, exacting with promises; affection appears in careful actions.

behavior.withStrangers: Asks clear questions without filling every silence.
behavior.withFriends: Remembers preferences and quietly solves practical problems.
behavior.withCrush: Makes time in a meticulous schedule and holds eye contact.
behavior.withLover: States desires precisely and allows unguarded tenderness.
behavior.withEnemy: Documents the issue and keeps her distance.

backstory: An architect who made her apartment orderly after years of constant moves.
goal: Design a public space that feels welcoming.
datingHistory: One long partnership; now selective and sexually self-aware.

activityAffinity.signature: rin: One round. Let us agree what we are playing for.

stages.name: A penciled appointment
stages.note: Rin's charcoal trousers and crisp shirt look as considered as the rooms she designs. She offers a dawn architecture walk with precise meeting details; alone she admits she likes anticipation, letting a quiet pause do the work of a louder flirt.

stages.name: A promise kept
stages.note: A fine-gauge sweater replaces the work shirt when she keeps a morning free for you. She starts inviting you to coffee without explaining it to onlookers; privately she asks what helps you relax when you can't see what's coming, listening more closely than the question first suggests.

stages.name: A room without spectators
stages.note: In a dark wrap dress, Rin invites you to stay after the other guests leave. Her public affection is a steady hand at your elbow when welcome; alone she brings out a blindfold and discusses slow teasing with the same deliberate care she gives a floor plan.

stages.name: The plan she revises for you
stages.note: She wears a silk camisole beneath an unstructured jacket and no longer makes desire sound like logistics. Publicly she asks for another date without disguising it as an errand; in private she proposes a restraint scene, checks the release, and leaves room for unscripted requests.

stages.name: An address called ours
stages.note: Rin greets you in a linen robe, the blindfold laid beside a plan she's quite willing to discard. Outside she acknowledges the relationship on terms you've agreed; behind her own door she initiates long teasing games, asks for the restraint she wants, and tells you plainly when she'd prefer to be held instead.

match.utterance: I will tell everyone about us.
What have you actually agreed with your partner?
You do not owe me a decision tonight.
Let us be honest about what this could cost.
Tell your partner you were working.
I arrived on time with the architecture book for our quiet morning.
I posted your private plans and left my clutter in your space.

activities.name: Explore a building's hidden details at dawn
activities.description: She points out a welcoming threshold and gives your observation the same exact attention as the building.

activities.name: Design a welcoming corner together
activities.description: She moves one object by agreement and admits that sharing a decision can feel peaceful.

activities.name: Plan a private blindfold and slow-teasing evening
activities.description: She sets privacy, release and check-in terms, then asks which parts of the evening you actually want.

route.firsts: Rin's wish for discretion does not imply a hidden partner or permission to invent an alibi. A private invitation can come at any stage; ask who may know what, and treat blindfolds or restraint as plans to agree on afresh rather than proof of permanent trust.

rewardSuggestions.suggestion: A place at her orderly breakfast table signals welcome without making her room the sole setting for intimacy.
An architecture book about a building you both lingered beside.
Revisit the shared corner and ask which detail still feels uncomfortable.
If her practice has a visitor area, suggest a daylight design review there.

shiftMoments.text: Rin moves a meeting so your agreed coffee break stays intact, then sets down two cups without calling attention to the effort; she asks what you noticed on the walk over.

sceneDrafts.title: A promise kept
sceneDrafts.opening: I kept the morning free. You can decide whether that means a walk or coffee here.

pages.text: A second cup is warming beside the first, but the walking shoes remain by the door. Rin gives you both possibilities without steering your answer: 'I wanted the time together; the route is negotiable.'

choices.label: Take the morning walk with her

sceneDrafts.title: The plan she revises for you
sceneDrafts.opening: I trust you with a plan that can change. Shall we discuss the blindfold and what either of us can stop?

pages.text: She draws a line through the last item on the page and turns it toward you. 'A plan isn't a promise to finish,' Rin says, pointing to the blindfold she hasn't yet picked up.

choices.label: Agree on a signal and scope

route.summary: An architect builds intimacy through kept promises, chosen privacy and plans that leave room for desire.

agenda.title: Design a public space that feels welcoming
agenda.why: A welcoming public space must work for its users. She wants decisions that stand up to observation and promises that survive the meeting.

steps.title: Observe who the public space leaves out
steps.description: On a quiet walk, Rin notes awkward thresholds, missing seating and where people hesitate. She asks for one precise observation.

steps.title: Review the welcoming-space sketch
steps.description: She draws a revised entrance and seating corner. You test the circulation together; she explains which change addresses which problem.

steps.title: Present the public-space proposal
steps.description: Rin checks the promised revisions, labels the plan and presents the welcoming-space proposal. A clear design replaces a vague intention.

wants.text: one useful observation about how a space welcomes people
a quiet walk that begins when agreed

ending.title: A place with room for people
ending.text: Rin sets the final proposal square with the table. "The entrance works better now," she says. After a pause: "So did working together." She offers a quiet walk and waits for your answer.
